# bioexcel/biobb_io/memprotmd_sim_search

## Summary

This class is a wrapper of the MemProtMD to perform advanced searches in the MemProtMD DB using its REST API.

Wrapper for the MemProtMD DB REST API to perform advanced searches.

Nextflow adapter of the [MemProtMDSimSearch](https://biobb-io.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html#module-api.memprotmd_sim_search) building block of [biobb_io](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_io) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_IO_MEMPROTMD_SIM_SEARCH } from 'bioexcel/biobb_io/memprotmd_sim_search'

workflow {
    BIOBB_IO_MEMPROTMD_SIM_SEARCH(channel.of([id: 'sample']))
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_simulations` | yes | json | Path to the output JSON file |
| `versions_biobb_io` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_io', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of MemProtMDSimSearch properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_simulations: 'json']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_io container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_IO_MEMPROTMD_SIM_SEARCH' {
        ext.properties = [keyword: 'porin']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection_name` | string | "refs" | Name of the collection to query. |
| `keyword` | string | null | String to search for in the database metadata. Examples are families like gpcr or porin. Values: porin, outer membrane protein, membrane protein, gpcr, ion channels, rhodopsin, abc, mip, ligand-gated, ammonia, mapeg, transmembrane, protein, kinase, glycoprotein, immunoglobulin, integrin, bnip3, bcl-2, atpase, cytochrome, nadp, a4, lysosome, necrosis, oxidoreductase, ceramidase, dehydrogenase, mitochondrial, plastid. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
